timingContract.clock: simulation milliseconds relative to castSkill resolution; primaryContact=0
timingContract.globalMultiplier: No 1.65 multiplier for migrated pilots; keep legacy path for unmigrated skills.
timingContract.anticipation: Only through audited existing visual windup; optional and cancellable. Never introduce damage delay.
timingContract.warning: All timing, scale and budget numbers are design targets pending visual verification, not RO measurements.

requiredArtifacts: full battlefield capture where GPU available

proposed.intent: Small inward-facing teeth form a hungry worm-mouth around the selected monster; forceful ground emergence and bite. Gameplay line targeting remains unchanged.

teeth.variation: Deterministic height, spacing and lean; avoid uniform fence.

phases.action: Primary contact/fissure compression immediately after cast resolution; optional existing windup can prepare rear roots only.
Teeth erupt and lean inward with staggered motion; cosmetic continuation of resolved contact.
Brief bite recoil/settle; keep center readable.
Teeth retract into roots; chips fall and dust settles.
Residual low dust only, then cleanup.

proposed.depth: Ground/rear pass below native target; front teeth above. Partition in world/projected depth and inspect crowded pack.
acceptance: 26 small teeth retained at reduced detail
readable weathered material at game scale
no plastic gloss or neon fence
bite/contact apparent at 1x on bright cobblestone

proposed.intent: Fast, sharp katar attack with compact contact and a decisive final cut; retain existing alternating direction.

phases.action: Primary localized strike agrees with synchronous cast resolution.
Eight staggered cosmetic cut accents, alternating established directions; no extra damage events.
Distinct finishing cut and compact metal fragments.
Rapid trail decay; retain target readability.

acceptance: first hit is immediate and localized
eight accents remain visually distinguishable at 1x without claiming timed gameplay hits

proposed.intent: Three clear downward fire contacts with hot painted cores and darker soot; retain downward trajectory.

phases.action: Primary contact cluster at target agrees with current damage resolution.
Three compact downward fire accents end in localized contacts; continuing motion is cosmetic, not delayed damage.
Hot flame folds collapse, separating from smoke.
Soot thins and embers die; no persistent pale blob.

proposed.timingFallback: If pre-impact travel is essential to the visual, use an audited existing visual windup hook. Without it, start near contact; do not delay gameplay.
acceptance: three visual contacts match declared hit identity
solid flame and darker soot separate
no target damage followed by long empty descent
